newsitem.title: UK: Greek gas oil buy tender postponed until Sept 24.
newsitem.headline: Greek gas oil buy tender postponed until Sept 24.

text.p: The Greek tender to purchase 500,000 to 600,000 tonnes of gas oil due to close this week has been postponed until September 24, traders said on Wednesday.
Traders said Greece had postponed the tender until after snap general elections due to take place on September 22.
The tender, originally due to close on September 17, was mainly for heating oil and possibly one or two cargoes of 0.05 percent diesel to be delivered from October 1996 to March 1997.
